title: Talk: The RL and Inference Scaling for Reasoning and Agents
desc: Guest talk by Zhenyu Hou (PhD @ Tsinghua KEG Lab). Covers how to scale RL for language models to improve complex reasoning and unlock inference-scaling capabilities. Recording: link

title: Talk: Expanding the Expressiveness of Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
desc: Guest talk by Yupeng Hou (PhD candidate @ UC San Diego, advised by Prof. Julian McAuley). Discusses extending semantic IDs from short to long forms (KDD'25) and moving to personalized semantic IDs. Recording: link

title: Talk: Towards World Models from Generative Spatial Intelligence
desc: Guest talk by Fangfu Liu (PhD @ Tsinghua EE, advised by Prof. Qifeng Chen). Explores learning unified world models from visual signals supporting generation, spatial reasoning, and causal inference.

title: Talk: Enhancing Large Language Models via Internal Supervision
desc: Guest talk by Weixiang Zhao (PhD @ HIT SCIR). Introduces mining internal supervision signals to enhance LLMs, reducing reliance on costly external data, covering multilingual capability, safety alignment, and reasoning efficiency. Recording: link
